metadata.description: THINK School — free, source-available AI Teams for people doing capture, proposal, growth, and grant work (start with Capture Team, Proposal Team, and Fulfillment) plus a full roster for content, sales, and ops. PolyForm Shield License: free to use, no competing product/service. Bring-your-own-data templates, no proprietary CL logic or pricing included. Link to this from Skool instead of pasting content directly.

plugins.name: lead-discovery
plugins.description: Scans procurement, grant, and funding sources weekly and scores each opportunity across 5 dimensions, surfacing a ranked, decision-ready shortlist of the deals worth pursuing. Built for people doing capture, proposal, growth, and grant work, whatever kind of organization they do it for.

plugins.name: proposal-generator
plugins.description: Runs one high-value deal through the full proposal methodology -- intake, research, assessment, positioning, drafting, and QA -- end to end, gated by your approval at each phase. A single-operator tool for one proposal at a time -- see Proposal Team for the multi-role pipeline. Bring your own company data -- fill in the customization/ files.

plugins.name: proposal-team
plugins.description: Runs a qualified opportunity through a full proposal pipeline -- research, deal assessment, competitive positioning, drafting, and QA -- producing a submission-ready proposal with your approval at each stage, plus a separate grant/funder track. 7 roles: Maya (lead), Chase, Priya, Porter, Quinn, Diego, Blair. Bring your own pricing, case studies, and brand guidelines.

plugins.name: content-team
plugins.description: Scans your content signal sources weekly and turns the strongest findings into newsletters, blog posts, LinkedIn posts, YouTube scripts, intelligence briefs, monthly theme proposals, a weekly owner brief, and full courses. 9 roles: Rohit, Ann, Joanna, Justin, Amy, Josh, Jay, Cal, Sal. Bring your own signal sources, ICP voice profiles, and Notion DB IDs.

plugins.name: sales-bd-team
plugins.description: Sources people and organizations actively signaling demand for what you sell, enriches and scores them against your ICP, then drafts and sends outreach and logs the resulting deal activity. 3 roles: Lori (Prospect Scout), Alex (BD Research), Sarah (BD Execution). Bring your own ICP, enrichment tool, and send-from config.

plugins.name: sales-enablement
plugins.description: Pulls completed client engagements and turns them into 1-page case study narratives tagged by buyer type, keeping a ready supply of proof points on hand for proposal and outreach work. Bring your own buyer tags and Notion DB IDs.

plugins.name: capture-team
plugins.description: Finds organizations and named groups worth pursuing, enriches and classifies inbound leads against your ICP, and turns raw signals into client-ready intelligence briefs. 3 roles: Chet (Cluster Discovery), Kipp (CRM Intake), Ben (Signal Delivery).

plugins.name: fulfillment
plugins.description: Builds customized onboarding, customer-success, and expansion playbooks for a specific active client, using your own base frameworks and that client's CRM record as inputs. Bring your own Notion DB IDs and templates.

plugins.name: ops-team
plugins.description: Keeps a website running well after every deploy -- auditing SEO, copy, and broken links; producing on-brand design assets and web specs; and managing the build pipeline, DNS, and CI. 3 roles: Jenny (Design Lead), Jason (QA Reviewer), Eric (Infra Lead). Bring your own site standards, brand guidelines, and infra config.
